claim_scope: One result-informed broad four-slab geometry with fixed absolute weights and fixed B=0.01, tested by a matrix-free killed-Doi finite-volume semigroup on two held-out odd cubic meshes in one fixed reflecting box.
limitations: result-informed fixed control and selected budget
two fixed-box finite-volume meshes, not a PDE or unbounded-domain proof
same solver family on both meshes, not independent-solver verification
floating-point sign-screen and root refinement, not interval certification
no physical d=3 or project/publication gate
